justification: Pure transform: DocumentNode → nested TocEntry tree.  Delegates heading slugification to @coding-adventures/forme-doc-heading-anchors (also pure-transform), then nests the flat heading list by level using a stack-based algorithm.  No eval, no Function, no JSON.parse-with-reviver, no fs/network/env/shell.  Both transitive dependencies (forme-doc-heading-anchors, document-ast) declare capabilities [].
